positive_tests: Overlapping and adjacent ranges merge without duplicate watched time.
Concurrent checkpoints from distinct instances serialize without lost writes through a shared lock.
Authenticated user and library keys remain isolated.
Stale schema and library fingerprints return empty factual summaries.
Finite duration caps ranges and completion, performance, today, and recent values derive from stored facts.
Quota and security failures keep current-session facts in memory and expose actionable status.
The player records only forward ranges of at least 15 seconds and rejects explicit forward and backward seeks without a time-gap heuristic.
Delayed format replacement carries the latest actual old-media position.
Malformed nested persisted lessons, intervals, activity, and timestamps return stale-schema without throwing.
Library identity and size or modified-time fingerprint changes create a distinct analytics service and cache key.
Heatmap and dashboard account endpoints settle independently and retain the successful source.
Pause, ended, lesson replacement, destroy, and format continuity preserve one logical range.
Dashboard account and local sources settle independently.
A deferred recorder initializes after a library folder is connected later.
Final focused suite passed with 38 tests.
Final full frontend suite passed with 104 tests.
Production build passed with 35 transformed modules.
A confirmed different directory selected through the production change-folder path rotates the library identity, while selecting or refreshing the same directory preserves it.
Unchanged rescans keep one analytics fingerprint even when scanner-generated media UUIDs change; stable media path and file facts drive invalidation.
negative_tests: Another user or library cannot read the scoped analytics key.
Replayed overlaps, adjacent checkpoints, and format switches do not inflate totals.
Forward seeks and playback shorter than 15 seconds are not recorded.
A stale catalog fingerprint does not reuse prior scan analytics.
Account API failure does not erase valid local data.
Local identity failure does not erase valid account data.
No folder produces an explicit unavailable summary and does not construct the service.
Persistence denial does not claim that current-session data was saved.
Changing folders cannot reuse analytics scoped to the prior directory.
Transient scanner UUID churn cannot invalidate unchanged-library analytics.

findings.evidence: Binding plan clarification applied: analytics persistence uses the injected IndexedDB adapter, not localStorage.
Persisted analytics contain only schema/fingerprint, opaque lesson IDs, display labels, finite duration, rounded intervals, and timestamps.
The arbiter base and head SHA remain identical because no commit was authorized.
Git diff check completed without whitespace errors.
All seven reviewer findings were reproduced before correction and passed after the focused fixes.
Both Task 4 rereview P1 findings were reproduced in RED and passed after the narrow identity and fingerprint fixes.

evidence: Service, player, dashboard settlement, concurrency, and deferred-connection behaviors each failed before implementation and passed afterward.
Final rereview-focused tests passed: 4 files and 68 tests.
Final full frontend tests passed: 16 files and 106 tests.
The final production build passed outside the restrictive sandbox.
No server, migration, package, secret, deployment, commit, or publication action occurred.
remaining_risks: Native media timing, codecs, background throttling, File System Access permissions, and real quota behavior require the later interactive browser gate.
Task 6 remains responsible for replacing legacy dashboard visual fixture rows with the factual source view model.
